goal: Material batch ZIP/brief, selected history export, continuous history viewing, local searches and structured similar material recommendations.

features.materialBatch: Exact atomic IDs, original PNG/SVG bytes and ordered reference briefs. ZIP failures retain selection; denied clipboard reveals readonly text.
features.historySelection: Visible record IDs are pruned on filtering/deletion. Selected image and full recipe archives snapshot records before async export.
features.historyNavigation: Page and panel share the filtered sequence, bounded previous/next buttons and arrow keys. Input/slider keys remain owned by their control.
features.search: Only explicitly committed normalized queries are saved, case-insensitive dedup, max8 entries/max120 characters. Recent history can be cleared, suggestions use own catalog titles for current role.
features.similarMaterials: Deterministic same-role max4, structured pose group/view/posture/camera/framing scores. Clothing lacks detailed structured matching metadata, so alternatives use stable catalog order. Recommendation preview never changes selected try-on refs and focuses new title.

browser.accessibility: New surfaces and active native dialogs have no serious/critical WCAG2A/AA violations. Existing background history card issues are outside this change.
browser.regression: Screenshot review found inherited horizontal search wrapper; fixed vertical stacking and added panel/input geometry assertions.

layoutGate.explanation: Successful gate consumed its active marker. Later CSS-only adjustment applies to catalog search; actual new catalog/history surfaces verified through browser screenshots, geometry, keyboard and accessibility checks.

privacy: Synthetic fixture and existing own catalog images only. No private photos accessed and no paid generation requests.
deployment: Local changes only, not committed or pushed.
